entries.title: Trial of the Crusader
body: The great arena of the Crusaders' Coliseum, where Tirion Fordring sets his greatest trials before the champions of the Horde and the Alliance: the fiercest beasts of Northrend, a demon lord of the Legion, the Lich King's own val'kyr. Only those who survive will be trusted at the front of the final assault.

entries.title: The Coliseum Floor
body: The arena itself, where the trials come one after another before Tirion's stand and the watching crowds.

entries.title: The Icy Depths
body: Caverns beneath the coliseum floor, part of the old nerubian tunnels under Icecrown, where something from Azjol-Nerub waits.

entries.title: The Beasts of Northrend
body: The first trial: Gormok the Impaler, the twin jormungar Acidmaw and Dreadscale, and Icehowl, brought from the wilds of Northrend to the arena.

entries.title: Lord Jaraxxus
body: An eredar lord of the Burning Legion, summoned into the arena by a warlock's ritual gone wrong.

entries.title: The Twin Val'kyr
body: Fjola Lightbane and Eydis Darkbane, val'kyr of the Lich King, one of light and one of darkness, sent to the coliseum by their master.

entries.title: Anub'arak, the Traitor King
body: The last king of Azjol-Nerub, slain once in his own kingdom. The Lich King raised him again and sent him into the caverns below Icecrown to plague the tournament. Beneath the coliseum, the traitor king met his final end.
